title: BACKND Base find user
summary: Look up another user's public information by nickname or by gamer inDate. Includes legacy (GetUserInfoByNickName) and v2 lookups; v2 variants are preferred for new work.
capabilities: route user-lookup questions to nickname or inDate variants
distinguish legacy lookups from v2 variants
clarify which public user fields are returned
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
A target nickname or gamer inDate is available
common_pitfalls: Using legacy GetUserInfoByNickName for new work instead of the v2 variant
Assuming private fields are returned by a public lookup
Expecting a unique result when nicknames are not unique
verification_required_for: exact method names and returned fields
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating lookup code.
Prefer v2 lookups; confirm returned fields upstream.
public_notes: Prefer v2 lookups over the legacy nickname API.
Only public user fields are returned.
